customFields.title: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Manage your custom fields and configurations

error.unauthorized: Please log in as an administrator

organizations.title: Companies
organizations.description: Balance, revenue, profit, listings and ad spend of every participating company. Click a column heading to sort.
organizations.supplyMismatch: * The MP ledger does not add up

tradeAnalysis.title: Trading bias
tradeAnalysis.lead: Shows mutual buying and reliance on a single partner as numbers.
tradeAnalysis.notice: This is not a judgement of cheating.
tradeAnalysis.detail: Buying from a friend because the product is genuinely good and buying from each other to score points look the same in the data. If a pair looks odd, ask the students themselves.

mutual.title: Mutual trade rate
mutual.description: Trade between the two companies / total trade of those two companies. Pairs above {{threshold}}% are highlighted. Two companies that trade only with each other reach 50% (the same amount is counted twice in the total).

concentration.title: Purchase concentration
concentration.lead: Share of everything a company bought that went to its biggest supplier.
concentration.notice: A company that bought from only one supplier is always at 100%.
concentration.detail: Companies that simply bought very few times also rise to the top, so read the number of suppliers and the amount together.

purchaseLog.title: Teacher purchase log
purchaseLog.lead: What each teacher bought and for how much is
purchaseLog.detail: It is here so that a teacher can notice their own unintended bias. Students cannot see this page.

bySeller.title: By company (bought by teachers)
bySeller.description: The number of teachers is shown as well, so you can tell whether one teacher bought a lot or many teachers bought a little.
